description: Agent -> Task mapping for orchestrator (core, bff, frontend). Used as a machine-readable guide for delegation.

rules.allowed_edit_surfaces: Each delegation must include an explicit list of allowed file paths. Agents must not write outside them.
rules.skills_injection: The orchestrator will inject SKILL.md paths in each delegation; agents must read them before modifying code.

verification.high: writer + independent verifier (security, migrations, public contracts)

rules.pr_gate: Do not prepare PR/MR for flows covered by this mapping until front<->bff<->core validation and QA evidence are recorded in odd/tasks/<feature>.md
